title: Preallocate join prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when join planning and indexed join probes build data and index scan prefixes from known component lengths.
implementation: Added join_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Added join_index_prefix_for_value() with explicit capacity for index:<table>:<column>:<value>:.
Replaced indexed join probe prefix construction.
Replaced comma-join row-count fallback data-prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Join prefix construction now reserves capacity from known component lengths while preserving indexed join probes, row-count fallback, and join query behavior.
